entries.acda5c854497f775: A flow business that provides the payment processing systems needed when customers operate processing themselves. It licenses the “CARD CREW” series of payment package software, designs, develops and introduces payment systems, develops payment terminal applications, and sells payment terminals and system equipment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 is ¥1,220 million.
entries.b3bc4a6e09da57c7: In addition to the payment package software “CARD CREW” series and payment terminals, it provides cloud-based payment ASP services and maintenance and operation services available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
entries.b8b908f1f123b219: It states that it aims to primarily target retail businesses operating multiple stores and works to expand its easy-to-introduce, low-cost, cloud-based payment ASP services. For existing customers that manage and operate their own payment systems in-house, the strategy is to guide them to payment ASP services at the time of replacement, thereby growing revenue in the Payment Services Business, a stock business. For payment terminals, it is expanding subscription-type sales in addition to outright sales, and states that its capital and business alliance with Transaction Media Networks, Inc., another affiliated company, will combine the services and functions of both companies to strengthen its proposal capabilities for customers.
entries.ce78f7d02568474a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,252 million. The Payment Integration Business accounted for ¥1,220 million and the Payment Services Business for ¥1,031 million; revenue rose 22.1% from the previous fiscal year, owing in part to strong terminal sales.
